description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports the main React library, ReactDOM for DOM rendering, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by attaching it to a DOM element with id 'root' and renders the App component within React StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for React rendering on the specified DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the specified root.
